name: KEITAI☆Guardian
source:
You are a high school junior. In a dream, a spirit called Darren tells you that there is a great danger coming towards the Human World and the Spirit World and the key to avoiding such danger is…you?

You are at the mercy of this sudden prophecy. Darren introduces you to three spirits, to help protect you.

Whichever spirit you choose to make a contract with will become your ‘KEITAI☆Guardian’, and stay in your cellphone to protect you 24 hours a day!
